paragraphs.text:
GREEK CONSULATE
Concerning Greek criminal matters, they advise visiting the 
Athens Bureau of Investigation on arrival. A Corporal Ilionas, 
they say, has handled the Gliere case. 
You ask for information about the National Museum and its 
treasures, but they have only an unhelpful travel brochure. They 
jokingly caution you about the cab drivers of Athens. You may 
go to any New York Location. 
(New York Location)
